causal_hypothesis: The exact pinned native-BF16 GLM-4.7-Flash stock runtime will allocate and load on one Secure A100 SXM 80 GB in the exact currently eligible US-KS-2 pool, then pass the frozen development smoke, fixed c1, and fixed c8 service gates with valid telemetry, runtime-logprob quality evidence, and a retrievable artifact.
falsification_value: A provider rejection or failure at the exact startup, compatibility, streaming-token observability, quality, or c1/c8 SLO boundary rejects this A100-SXM stock-control path before paying for a tuned control, c32 headline point, or AWQ comparison.
intervention: Placement only: A100 PCIe is replaced by the distinct A100 SXM provider SKU, exact Secure US-KS-2 pool, CUDA 13 filter, and non-interruptible request. No runtime, model, representation, serving, or source intervention is present.

quality_gate.capture: exact executable fixtures plus raw runtime input-token logprobs
quality_gate.comparison: stock responses self-paired only to validate the BF16 control and scorer
requirements: teacher-forced NLL is recomputed from raw runtime logprobs
deterministic serving fixtures are internally consistent
no malformed tool or code evidence

provider_request.name: glm47flash-c100-b-stock-a100-sxm-secure-v3-20260713
provider_request.changed_from_failed_placement: Secure A100 SXM in exact CUDA-13/disk-positive US-KS-2 replaces globally scheduled Secure A100 PCIe; all model and workload controls remain frozen.
provider_request.capacity_semantics: non-interruptible after allocation; not a sales-reserved initial-capacity guarantee
provider_request.image_cache_semantics: exact digest is pinned; provider image pre-pull is not selectable or guaranteed

kill_conditions: The exact provider request is rejected before pod creation.
No public artifact endpoint exists within 900 seconds.
The pinned model or native SGLang implementation fails import, download identity, load, or health.
Any profile runner emits a typed error, truncation, unobservable token-level ITL, or fails its frozen SLO.
The development quality capture or self-score fails.
Artifact retrieval or remote hash verification fails.
The allocation reaches the absolute deadline.
Returned hourly price exceeds $1.49; the orchestrator must delete immediately.

next_step_rules.on_valid_stock_pass: Analyze the profiler and preregister the cheapest supported tuned-incumbent A/B on the exact same A100-SXM placement; c32 remains conditional.
next_step_rules.on_provider_rejection: Record zero-cost placement falsification and do not repeat US-KS-2 unchanged; US-MD-1 is an observed alternate but is not automatically authorized by this preregistration.
next_step_rules.on_native_or_slo_failure: Stop this A100-SXM stock path unless one measured, offline-correctable harness defect is identified; do not repeat the placement unchanged.
next_step_rules.on_artifact_failure: At most one corrected retry with the artifact defect and causal change recorded.
next_step_rules.on_quality_failure: Do not promote serving or economic claims.

claim_boundary: This experiment can establish a stock placement, compatibility, service, quality-screen, telemetry, and GPU-only economic control. It cannot establish a tuned-stack gain, AWQ advantage, provider comparison, model-specific intervention, hardware co-design advantage, capacity reservation, or image-cache guarantee.
